name: Colorado Cubing Weekend 2026
information: Welcome back to Frisco for a fun weekend of cubing in the mountains! You MUST read the required tabs on the website before registering for the competition. This competition is brought to you by Colorado Cubers, our local non-profit dedicated to enhancing the cubing community in Colorado. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTA4NTkzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--73ecaa7ba0cf4a848c216b007810195084962b58/image.png) If you would like to be a staff member at this competition, you MUST complete the application on the corresponding tab in order to receive the full benefits.
